+import re
+import sys
+from rich.highlighter import ReprHighlighter
+from rich.text import Text, Span
+
+def check():
+    # Test case for URL with '@'
+    url_with_at = "http://user@example.com/path"
+    
+    # The regex is: r"(?P<url>(file|https|http|ws|wss)://[-0-9a-zA-Z$_+!@`(),.?/;:&=%#~]*)"
+    url_regex = r"(?P<url>(file|https|http|ws|wss)://[-0-9a-zA-Z$_+!@`(),.?/;:&=%#~]*)"
+    
+    matches = list(re.finditer(url_regex, url_with_at))
+    
+    if len(matches) != 1:
+        print("CHECK_FAIL: Expected exactly one match for URL with '@', but found", len(matches))
+        return
+    
+    match = matches[0]
+    matched_string = match.group(0)
+    
+    if matched_string != url_with_at:
+        print(f"CHECK_FAIL: Matched string mismatch. Expected '{url_with_at}', got '{matched_string}'")
+        return
+
+    print("CHECK_PASS")
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    check()
